ruleDefinitions.name: SCR File Write Event
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of screensaver files (.scr) outside of system folders. Attackers may execute an application as an ".SCR" file using "rundll32.exe desk.cpl,InstallScreenSaver" for example.

sequences.query: file_path = RGX("\\\.scr$") AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\\\$WINDOWS\\\.\\~BT\\\\NewOS\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\.*") OR file_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\WUDownloadCache\\\\.*")))
